name: typecv
description: Computer vision in TypeScript with TypeShade-based GPU execution.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:gpu
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:shade
scripts.test:website: node --test website/sift-quality.test.mjs website/guided-matching.test.mjs website/worker.test.mjs website/pose-alignment.test.mjs website/sfm-scene.test.mjs website/site.test.mjs
scripts.test:shade: node --test tests/typeshade/cpu.test.mjs tests/typeshade/tiled.test.mjs tests/typeshade/plan-steps.test.mjs tests/typeshade/bundle-checkpoint.test.mjs tests/typeshade/solver-checkpoint.test.mjs tests/typeshade/focal.test.mjs tests/typeshade/pyramid-features.test.mjs tests/typeshade/pair-retry.test.mjs tests/typeshade/sift.test.mjs tests/typeshade/float-matching.test.mjs tests/typeshade/float-mapper.test.mjs tests/typeshade/schur-cache.test.mjs tests/typeshade/streaming.test.mjs tests/typeshade/device-pool.test.mjs tests/typeshade/pair-terminal-readback.test.mjs tests/typeshade/bundle-admission.test.mjs tests/typeshade/pair-batch.test.mjs tests/typeshade/pnp-batch.test.mjs tests/typeshade/mvs.test.mjs tests/typeshade/mvs-geometric.test.mjs
